content_sections.heading: KU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. KU/DR/U-2/SRF/Advt./2253/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.F.Sc. in any Discipline of Fisheries Science; OR post graduate degree in basic sciences (marine biology, aquatic biology, zoology, microbiology) with 3 years' bachelor's degree and 2 years' master degree, should have NET qualification Age limit: Max 35 years for male and 40 years for female candidate Age relaxation: Female candidate Max. 40 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment purely on contractual basis No employment will be provided after completion of the research scheme Services may be terminated without any notice at any time by the University Fellowship structure covers 1st, 2nd and 3rd year

content_sections.heading: How Will KU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test (if the number of candidates is more, to shortlist) Walk-in Interview A written test will be conducted to shortlist candidates if the candidates are more

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application on plain paper Complete bio-data (Bio-data Form) All the documents (originals) A set of self-attested photocopies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the walk-in interview on 14-12-2026 at 11:00 AM at Office of Research Officer, Fisheries Research Station, Kamdhenu University, Sikka-361140. Bring the application on plain paper along with complete bio-data. Bring all the documents and a set of self-attested photocopies. Bio-data form is given with the notice.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Post is under the plan scheme 'Establishment of pearl oyster hatchery at Sikka' (B.H. 0116070118)

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 14 December 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 14 December 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of Research Officer, Fisheries Research Station, Kamdhenu University, Sikka.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is max 35 years for male and 40 years for female candidate. Relaxation: Female candidate Max. 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for 1st and 2nd year; Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA for 3rd year.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.F.Sc. in any Discipline of Fisheries Science OR post graduate degree in basic sciences (marine biology, aquatic biology, zoology, microbiology) with 3 years' bachelor's degree and 2 years' master degree, should have NET qualification.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test (if the number of candidates is more, to shortlist). Walk-in Interview. A written test will be conducted to shortlist candidates if the candidates are more.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment purely on contractual basis. No employment will be provided after completion of the research scheme. Services may be terminated without any notice at any time by the University.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by KU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fisheries Research Station, Kamdhenu University, Sikka, Islands and intertidal region of Gulf of Kachchh (travel for survey, collection and sea ranching).
